mapping_rationale: The source has tier=gold and an explicit drift_step, so it can provide a provisional onset target. The supplied metadata has no non-empty reviewed_by entries; GoalGuard has not independently reviewed these annotations.
This is a trajectory-level misalignment label without a validated drift onset. It is preserved in source metadata and is not converted into step labels.
A trajectory-level negative does not identify which steps were aligned and cannot establish step-level labels.
Ambiguous, pending-review, or contested labels must remain separate from approved training targets.
Execution failures are not automatically goal drift. This source is retained for supplementary analysis only and excluded from model training.
